finding.headline: Minecraft Classic has no hold-repeat and no dig progress. One click is one block.
evidence: mc-12-break-hold-80/200/400/800.png and mc-13-break-done.png share MD5 a57c9d9730e33b45820fff8ce5628de9 — five frames spanning an 80ms->800ms hold plus the frame after release, pixel-for-pixel identical.
noa.setBlock was wrapped in the live page and timestamped. Across four runs a 2.6 s hold produced 0 or 1 voxel writes; discrete clicks in the same pose did produce writes.

Aim is the hard part of this probe, not the measurement: a random seed spawns you on a beach or a cliff lip as often as flat ground, and a crosshair on water or open sky registers nothing. Runs 2-4 are recorded here with their poses so the zeros can be read correctly.
finding.consequence: Any hold-repeat at all beats the bar. Ours is PLACE_REPEAT_MS 140 (7.1 Hz) / BREAK_REPEAT_MS 120, bounded by our own server MAX_EDITS_PER_SECOND=20 rather than by the bar.
